Auguſtin wherwith the wel was cloſed. † And hauing watered the II (q. in Gen) flocke, he : kiſſed her: and lifting vp his voice wept, † and he told her that he was her fathers brother, and the ſonne of Rebecca : but ihe in haſt went and told her father. † Who and frendes as when he heard that Iacob his ſiſters ſonne was come, he a laudable cu ranne forth to mete him: and embracing him, and hartely kiſſing him, brought him into his houſe. And when he kad heard the cauſes of his iourney, † he anſwered : Thou art my more ciuil bone and my fleſh. And after the dayes of one moneth were expired, † he ſaid to him: becauſe thou art my brother, ſhalt thou ſerue me gratis Tel me what wages wilt thou take. † He had in dede two daughters, the name of the vva- elder was Lia: and the younger was called Rachel. † But Lia ges was bleare eyed: Rachel wel fauored, and of a bewtiful coun- tenance. † Whom Iacob louing, ſaid : I wil ſerue thee for Rachel thy younger daughter, ſeauen veares. † Laban an ſwered : It is better that I geue her to thee then to an other man, tary with me. † Iacob therfore ſerued for Rachel ſeuen yeares : and they ſemed a few dayas becauſe of the greatnes of his loue. † And he ſaid to Laban: geue me my wife: becauſe now the time is complete, that I may companie with ber. † Who hauing bid a great number of his freinds to the feaſt, made the mariage. † And at night : he brought in Lia his daughter to him, † geuing his daughter a handmaid, named Zelpha. With whom when Iacob had companed after the maner, when morning was come he ſaw Lia : and he ſaid to his father in lawe : What is it that thou dideſt meane to doe did not I ſerue thee for Rachel why haſt thou deceiued me: † Laban anſwered :26 It is not the. cuſtome in this place, that we beſtowe the daies he hadyounger in mariage firſt. † Make vp the : wecke of dayes
